senses.gloss:
Śeva-dhi denotes ‘treasure’ in the Rigveda^1 and later.^2
1) ii. 13, 6; vii. 53, 5; ix. 3, 15
(metaphorically). Cf. viii. 52, 9.
2) Av. v. 22, 14; Vājasaneyi Saṃhitā,
xviii. 59, etc.

Śevṛdha and Śevṛdhaka are the names of snakes or demons
in the Atharvaveda.^1
1) ii. 24, 1. Cf. Whitney Translation of the Atharvaveda, 64.
